item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\npolicy=json.load(open('policy.json'))\\nrequests=json.load(open('requests.json'))\\nresults=[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]\\nprint(json.dumps(results,sort_keys=True))\\nchecks=[\\n ({'from':'missing','to':'edge','role':'x','attempts':0},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),\\n ({'from':'ready','to':'running','role':'wrong','attempts':'bad'},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),\\n ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':True},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),\\n ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':-1},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),\\n ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':1},{'ok':True,'value':'ready','reason':'ok'}),\\n ({'from':'failed','to':'ready','attempts':2},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),\\n]\\nfor req,expected in checks:\\n before_req=copy.deepcopy(req); before_policy=copy.deepcopy(policy); actual=evaluate(req,policy); assert actual==expected,(req,actual,expected); assert req==before_req and policy==before_policy\\nprint('boundary checks passed')\"]}"}
